source_assets.text:
<!--
  Development fixture for deterministic controller-progress recovery evidence.

  Unlike Nav2's stock tree, this tree does not continuously replace the active
  controller path. A FollowPath progress failure is followed by an Ackermann-safe
  Wait action and a bounded retry. The exact XML must be retained with captures;
  this is a controlled research fixture, not CRANE's general navigation policy.
-->
<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
  <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
    <RecoveryNode number_of_retries="2" name="NavigateRecovery">
      <Sequence name="NavigateAttempt">
        <ComputePathToPose goal="{goal}" path="{path}" planner_id="GridBased"
                           error_code_id="{compute_path_error_code}"/>
        <FollowPath path="{path}" controller_id="FollowPath"
                    error_code_id="{follow_path_error_code}"/>
      </Sequence>
      <Sequence name="ProgressRecovery">
        <WouldAControllerRecoveryHelp error_code="{follow_path_error_code}"/>
        <Wait wait_duration="1.0"/>
      </Sequence>
    </RecoveryNode>
  </BehaviorTree>
</root>

# Configurable proving-ground parameters. Kept separate from the warehouse and hash-governed
# controlled-land configurations. The 44 m rolling global window contains an 18 m goal at startup
# and the complete 22 m canonical testbed while preserving the warehouse-qualified TurtleBot3
# footprint, inflation, controller, and recovery behavior.
controller_server:
  ros__parameters:
    use_sim_time: true
    odom_topic: /crane/odom
    controller_frequency: 10.0
    costmap_update_timeout: 0.5
    min_x_velocity_threshold: 0.001
    min_y_velocity_threshold: 0.001
    min_theta_velocity_threshold: 0.001
    failure_tolerance: 0.0
    progress_checker_plugins: [progress_checker]
    goal_checker_plugins: [goal_checker]
    controller_plugins: [FollowPath]
    progress_checker:
      plugin: nav2_controller::SimpleProgressChecker
      required_movement_radius: 0.10
      movement_time_allowance: 10.0
    goal_checker:
      plugin: nav2_controller::SimpleGoalChecker
      stateful: true
      xy_goal_tolerance: 0.55
      yaw_goal_tolerance: 3.14
    FollowPath:
      plugin: nav2_regulated_pure_pursuit_controller::RegulatedPurePursuitController
      desired_linear_vel: 0.26
      lookahead_dist: 0.8
      min_lookahead_dist: 0.4
      max_lookahead_dist: 1.2
      lookahead_time: 1.5
      rotate_to_heading_angular_vel: 0.4
      transform_tolerance: 0.2
      use_velocity_scaled_lookahead_dist: true
      use_collision_detection: true
      use_rotate_to_heading: false
      allow_reversing: true
      max_robot_pose_search_dist: 30.0

local_costmap:
  local_costmap:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
      global_frame: odom
      robot_base_frame: base_link
      rolling_window: true
      update_frequency: 10.0
      publish_frequency: 2.0
      width: 12
      height: 12
      resolution: 0.05
      robot_radius: 0.22
      plugins: [obstacle_layer, inflation_layer]
      obstacle_layer:
        plugin: nav2_costmap_2d::ObstacleLayer
        enabled: true
        observation_sources: scan
        scan:
          topic: /scan
          data_type: LaserScan
          marking: true
          clearing: true
          min_obstacle_height: 0.0
          max_obstacle_height: 2.0
          obstacle_min_range: 0.1
          obstacle_max_range: 15.0
          raytrace_min_range: 0.1
          raytrace_max_range: 20.0
      inflation_layer:
        plugin: nav2_costmap_2d::InflationLayer
        cost_scaling_factor: 3.0
        inflation_radius: 0.55
      always_send_full_costmap: false

planner_server:
  ros__parameters:
    use_sim_time: true
    expected_planner_frequency: 5.0
    costmap_update_timeout: 1.0
    planner_plugins: [GridBased]
    GridBased:
      plugin: nav2_navfn_planner::NavfnPlanner
      tolerance: 0.5
      use_astar: true
      allow_unknown: true

global_costmap:
  global_costmap:
    ros__parameters:
      use_sim_time: true
      global_frame: odom
      robot_base_frame: base_link
      rolling_window: true
      track_unknown_space: false
      update_frequency: 5.0
      publish_frequency: 1.0
      width: 44
      height: 12
      resolution: 0.10
      robot_radius: 0.22
      plugins: [obstacle_layer, inflation_layer]
      obstacle_layer:
        plugin: nav2_costmap_2d::ObstacleLayer
        enabled: true
        observation_sources: scan
        scan:
          topic: /scan
          data_type: LaserScan
          marking: true
          clearing: true
          min_obstacle_height: 0.0
          max_obstacle_height: 2.0
          obstacle_min_range: 0.1
          obstacle_max_range: 15.0
          raytrace_min_range: 0.1
          raytrace_max_range: 20.0
      inflation_layer:
        plugin: nav2_costmap_2d::InflationLayer
        cost_scaling_factor: 3.0
        inflation_radius: 0.55
      always_send_full_costmap: false

behavior_server:
  ros__parameters:
    use_sim_time: true
    local_costmap_topic: local_costmap/costmap_raw
    global_costmap_topic: global_costmap/costmap_raw
    local_footprint_topic: local_costmap/published_footprint
    global_footprint_topic: global_costmap/published_footprint
    cycle_frequency: 10.0
    behavior_plugins: [spin, backup, drive_on_heading, wait]
    spin:
      plugin: nav2_behaviors::Spin
    backup:
      plugin: nav2_behaviors::BackUp
    drive_on_heading:
      plugin: nav2_behaviors::DriveOnHeading
    wait:
      plugin: nav2_behaviors::Wait
    local_frame: odom
    global_frame: odom
    robot_base_frame: base_link
    transform_tolerance: 0.2
    simulate_ahead_time: 2.0
    max_rotational_vel: 0.5
    min_rotational_vel: 0.1
    rotational_acc_lim: 0.5

bt_navigator:
  ros__parameters:
    use_sim_time: true
    global_frame: odom
    robot_base_frame: base_link
    odom_topic: /crane/odom
    bt_loop_duration: 10
    default_server_timeout: 20
    wait_for_service_timeout: 1000
    action_server_result_timeout: 60.0
    navigators: [navigate_to_pose]
    navigate_to_pose:
      plugin: nav2_bt_navigator::NavigateToPoseNavigator
    error_code_names: [compute_path_error_code, follow_path_error_code]

lifecycle_manager_controller:
  ros__parameters:
    use_sim_time: true
    autostart: true
    bond_timeout: 4.0
    node_names: [controller_server, planner_server, behavior_server, bt_navigator]

This lower-speed profile is selected on inspected development run diagnostic-land-binding-dev-007 and must be fixed before a fresh composition run.",
  "parameters": {
    "window_seconds": 1.0,
    "minimum_command_samples_per_window": 5,
    "minimum_odometry_samples_per_window": 20,
    "calibration_window_count": 5,
    "minimum_commanded_speed_mps": 0.1,
    "minimum_healthy_measured_speed_mps": 0.05,
    "maximum_discrepancy_response_ratio": 0.2,
    "minimum_consecutive_discrepancy_windows": 3
  },
  "interpretation": "The threshold only selects sufficiently commanded windows and defines a low-response ratio relative to the within-run healthy comparator. It does not establish actuator acceptance, Nav2 odometry consumption, collision, slip, obstruction, or an evaluator intervention.",
  "allowed_use": "Development recomputation and prospectively declared fresh land-composition runs only. Existing results are not rescored into confirmatory evidence."
